compiled:
📰 General

Ismael Bonfim’s Weight Miss Threatens His UFC Vegas 111 Fight •

Ismael Bonfim, scheduled to fight in UFC Vegas 111, failed to meet the required weight limit for his bout. The fighter missed the weight by a significant 5 pounds, triggering standard UFC protocols. This infraction could impact his participation in the main event, where he was slated to compete alongside his brother, Gabriel Bonfim. The UFC will now assess the situation and determine the next steps regarding his fight.

🌍 World

Australia Announces Landmark Ban on Social Media for Under-16s – Enforcement Looms •

The Australian government is implementing a new law prohibiting social media access for individuals under 16, commencing December 10th. Social media companies will be subject to substantial fines, up to €28 million, if they fail to prevent children from using their platforms. The legislation aims to address concerns regarding the negative impacts of social media on young people’s mental health and development. Authorities are currently exploring methods for enforcement, including potential technological solutions and increased monitoring of online activity.

🦅 US

Intense Fighting Rages for Pokrovsk as Ukraine Mobilizes Elite Forces •

Heavy fighting continues in Pokrovsk, a strategically important city in Ukraine’s Donetsk region, with both Russian and Ukrainian forces engaged in close-quarters combat. Soldiers report battles extending to the control of individual buildings, indicating a highly localized and dynamic conflict. Ukrainian forces have begun deploying their most elite units to bolster defenses and push back against the Russian advance. Analysts believe the battle for Pokrovsk could conclude within weeks due to the intensity of the fighting and the strategic value of the location.

💰 Business

Taco Bell’s Baja Blast Pie Launch Sparks Unexpected Buzz and Demand •

Taco Bell introduced its new Baja Blast pie on Thursday, capitalizing on the popularity of the beverage. The limited-time dessert combines the iconic Mountain Dew flavor with a pie crust and whipped cream. Initial reactions online have been overwhelmingly positive, with significant demand reported across social media platforms. Taco Bell has stated that the pie is available at participating locations while supplies last, leading to rapid sell-out in some areas.

💻 Technology

Samsung Zero-Click Vulnerability Used to Deploy Sophisticated Android Spyware •

A recently discovered security flaw within Samsung Galaxy Android devices was utilized by attackers to install LANDFALL, a commercial-grade spyware. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-21042, allowed for zero-click exploitation, meaning the spyware was installed without user interaction. Targeted attacks occurred in the Middle East, suggesting a focused and deliberate campaign. The flaw has since been patched by Samsung, mitigating the immediate risk to users.

🎭 Entertainment

Rosé & Bruno Mars’ “APT.” Leads K-Pop Nominations for 2026 Grammys •

The 2026 Grammy Awards announced several significant nominations, highlighting the growing influence of K-pop and music created by Koreans. Rosé’s collaboration with Bruno Mars’ “APT.” is among the nominees, alongside the soundtrack to the series “KATSEYE.” Additionally, the “Maybe Happy Ending” soundtrack also received a nomination for consideration. The announcement marks a notable recognition of Korean artists and their contributions to the music industry.

🏅 Sports

Disney Execs Remain Firm on YouTube TV Dispute Ahead of Sports Weekend •

Disney Entertainment Co-Chairs Dana Walden and Alan Bergman, alongside ESPN Chairman Jimmy Pitaro, expressed gratitude to employees for their continued focus amidst the ongoing carriage dispute with YouTube TV. The executives acknowledged the approaching “sports-packed weekend” and maintained Disney’s stance on the negotiations. The conflict centers around Disney’s demand for increased payments from YouTube TV in exchange for airing ESPN channels. Disney continues to assert that YouTube TV’s current revenue model doesn’t adequately compensate them for the value of their sports programming.

🔬 Science

Lunar Halo Creates Stunning Ring Around Moon Over St. Louis Tuesday Night •

A prominent lunar halo appeared over St. Louis, Missouri, on Tuesday night, offering a unique celestial display for residents. The phenomenon was caused by ice crystals suspended in high-altitude cirrus clouds, refracting moonlight. These clouds, forming due to a cold front, created a bright ring surrounding the full moon. Experts noted this was one of the brightest and closest full moon events of 2025, contributing to the visibility of the halo.

🩺 Health

Doctors Share Shocking Cases of Patients Correctly Self-Diagnosing Conditions •

Medical professionals have recounted instances where patients accurately identified their ailments after self-diagnosing. One patient presented to a clinic believing their neighbor was administering poison, a claim initially dismissed by staff. Another case involved a patient who correctly identified a rare autoimmune disorder based on their own research and symptoms. These anecdotes highlight the potential value of patient self-awareness and the importance of considering patient-reported information. The experiences underscore the need for healthcare providers to engage with patients’ perspectives.
